Use case: compositing / product-mockup. Edit the supplied product photograph into a finished WEBSITE HERO BACKGROUND, LANDSCAPE 16:9, 1920x1080 composition. Subject: The single black cotton FUTURE PRO t-shirt, rear view, exact white/cyan logo and garment shape.
Preserve the exact referenced product(s) and printed artwork without inventing merchandise or logos. Recompose and extend the setting, not the product design. Photorealistic professional commercial studio photograph with real cotton grain, believable soft directional light, grounded natural shadows. Restrained black and smoky lilac seamless cyclorama, matte, subtle natural light falloff, no hard horizon, no props or platforms.
STRATEGIC LAYOUT: leftmost 48% of the full image must be EMPTY DARK SMOKY PLUM negative space for large white HTML headline and buttons. All products are in the RIGHT half, occupying x=53% through 92%, y=14% through 82%. Entire silhouette visible, minimum 8% breathing room at right, minimum 14% at top and 18% at bottom for website crop and controls. Choose a pulled-back camera distance; products must NOT fill the whole frame. The products and every important logo must remain unobstructed in the right half. Harmonize with lilac brand without recoloring products. Preserve fine detail. Left side quiet and clear, right side crisp and inviting. No overlaid text, captions, promotional lettering, watermark, fake company scenes, people or extra branding. No borders or collage. ONE wide image.
